label: Jakarta
short_description: The Sudirman-Thamrin business corridor, Mega Kuningan's embassy row and Jakarta's old town.
intro: Jakarta's hotels in this directory cluster around the city's business and diplomatic districts: the high-rise Sudirman-Thamrin corridor (the Golden Triangle), the embassy-and-mall enclave of Mega Kuningan, and the shopping-heavy Central Jakarta area near Grand Indonesia and Plaza Indonesia. Traffic is famously heavy, so proximity to a hotel's own district and to the MRT or a toll-road on-ramp matters more than straight-line distance to the airport (Soekarno-Hatta is well to the west of the city).
